description: This file defines the TestDB package, which extends a test database class and provides methods for initializing test data, executing SQL scripts, and performing test assertions related to database deployment and upgrades. It includes class methods, package functions, and references external modules for testing and deployment.

classes.name: TestDB
classes.description: A test database class extending DBICx::TestDatabase, providing methods for initializing and executing test data, and performing deployment-related tests.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Initializes a new test database schema, optionally loading test data from a SQL file.

methods.name: execute_test_data
methods.description: Executes SQL statements from a specified file to populate the test database.
